rounds.title: Game Show Style
rounds.instructions: Varies weekly: True/False, Name That Tune, Multiple Choice, or Family Feud.

questions.clue: Bananas grow on trees.
questions.explanation: Bananas grow on large herbaceous plants, not trees. The structure often mistaken for a trunk is actually a 'pseudostem' made of tightly packed leaf bases.

questions.clue: Octopuses have three hearts.
questions.explanation: Octopuses possess three hearts: two pump blood to the gills, while the third pumps it to the rest of the body. This unique circulatory system supports their active lifestyle in the ocean.

questions.clue: The shortest war in history was between Britain and France.
questions.explanation: The shortest war in history was between Britain and Zanzibar on August 27, 1896, lasting only 38 minutes. France was not involved in this conflict.
